candidates.name: Ratawi (Artawi)–PS1 Export Pipeline

evidence.note: TotalEnergies started up a new 24-inch, 30-km export pipeline connecting the Ratawi oilfield to the PS-1 pumping station in North Rumaila, enabling crude evacuation as Ratawi expands from 60,000 to 100,000 b/d; PS-1 has 5.2 million barrels of storage capacity.
Confirms the Artawi-PS1 export pipeline project was 95% finalised as part of TotalEnergies' $27bn four-project Iraq megaproject (GGIP), alongside gas capture from Ratawi and other southern fields.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster segment matches this route/spec: the only existing PS1-linked oil lines are Zubair 2—PS1 (P5285, 38 km, 42in, from Zubair 2 Storage) and PS1-Az Zubayr (P6172, 37 km, 36in) and PS1-Fao/PS1-Tuba — none originate at Ratawi/Artawi oilfield or match 30 km/24-inch. This is a distinct, newly-built (Feb 2026 startup) crude transmission line feeding PS1 from the Ratawi field, not represented under any existing PID.
